myExperiences.title: My experiences
myExperiences.description: Over the past 7 years, I’ve worked as a frontend developer for international teams and large-scale projects in Europe and Asia. My experience spans industries like real estate, banking, and digital marketing — where I helped build performant, maintainable UIs and contributed to core architecture decisions. I thrive in cross-functional teams and love turning complex product requirements into smooth user experiences.
